plaatsen.tekst: For they fled from the swords, from the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, and from the grievousness of war.
All thy rulers are fled together, they are bound by the archers: all that are found in thee are bound together, which have fled from far.
At the noise of the tumult the people fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations were scattered.

Woe unto them! for they have fled from me: destruction unto them! because they have transgressed against me: though I have redeemed them, yet they have spoken lies
But the sons of Belial shall be all of them as thorns thrust away, because they cannot be taken with hands:
